instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a wide shot of a group of friends sitting in a row on the grass. On the left, the woman with a large afro (R6) leans on a large black inflatable bowling ball. Next to her, the man in a red polo shirt (R3) and the woman in a black beanie (R5) sit holding white inflatable bowling pins. Further right, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) and the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) hold their pins, while the large man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) sits on the far right laughing with his pin raised. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene.
elements: R6 leans on the large black inflatable bowling ball rather than holding a bowling pin
R1 has his inflatable bowling pin raised while R2 is only described as holding his pin
R3 and R5 sit holding white inflatable bowling pins
R4 and R2 hold their inflatable bowling pins
group seated outdoors on grass in bright daylight
